items.summary: Recommendation: approve no new production, spend, revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claims this cycle. The only reported Amazon revenue is $4.92 for 2026-09-21, all in an unattributed aggregate row; site-attributed income is $0 despite 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. AI spend is $921.96 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25 across 5,093 calls, so revenue-to-AI comparisons are temporally invalid and indicate severe exposure if treated as an economic return. Full contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, domains, labor, and other operating costs are absent; monthly budget, fixed-cost, marketing, and revenue-floor fields are blank. Continue existing measurement and failure repair only, and retain one report-only finance cost-and-attribution baseline.

Financial control position: treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, SEO scores, ordered items, and affiliate clicks as operating metrics, not revenue or margin. Do not forecast revenue from the 28 aggregate ordered items or assign the $4.92 aggregate commission to any site. The minimum missing inputs for contribution margin are date-aligned site-level revenue, AI cost, infrastructure/hosting cost, domain cost, paid marketing cost, and approved labor or agent cost, plus a defined budget period and ownership.
